WowType voice (wowtype-voice)
Source: https://github.com/Gloridust/WowType
Pinned revision: 1e31c67d9ba0357a0138d552b652c8b70a995c52

WowType's README declares its code dual-licensed under MIT OR Apache-2.0.
WebShell selects the Apache-2.0 license (included as LICENSE-APACHE).
WebShell uses the voice library without microphone/hotkey features. No WowType
word lists, language model, emoji data or Tencent speech model are distributed.
The original wtlocal provenance and author permission notice is in NOTICE.md.
Speech models remain Tencent resources and are downloaded separately, on request.
